data.headline: CSM® | Domain Lead | Senior Consultant | US Healthcare
data.about: Experienced Healthcare Consultant with a demonstrated history of working in the Information Technology, Consulting & Services industry. Skilled in Business Analysis, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Use Case, Agile and BRD. Strong US Healthcare domain expert professional with a Master of Business Administration (M.B.A.) focused in Information Technology from Pune University.

description.text:
•	Spearheaded techno-functional solutions for government-sponsored healthcare programs (Medicaid and CHIP) using DentalTrac, managing business requirements from discovery through delivery, and enhancing workflow processes, contributing to a 10% improvement in dental care service delivery efficiency.
•	Led requirements gathering for new functions and the migration from Microsoft CRM 2015 to cloud based intuitive Microsoft Dynamics 365, conducting customer interviews, workshops, and document analysis to elicit, document, and prioritize business requirements, resulting in a 15% gain in user productivity.
•	Developed technical documentation, including functional specifications, workflows, and user stories, to bridge communication between technical and non-technical teams, designed product prototypes for user feedback, translating insights into actionable features for future releases, and reducing development rework
•	Resolved issues related to Medicaid eligibility of members and provider networks to ensure compliance with State specific regulatory standards, and implemented process improvements, including fixing a workflow loophole that resulted in a 7% cost saving for the client in Medicaid ID card and Welcome packet delivery.
•	Utilized data analysis tools (e.g., SQL) to extract, analyze, and report on healthcare data, supporting decision-making and improving process efficiency. 
•	Designed and implemented SharePoint lists and libraries to organize and track key project deliverables, ensuring alignment with business objectives 
•	Delivered end user training material that helped in increased user productivity by 20% and reducing support tickets by 10% 
•	Collaboration with different stakeholders and liaison with the client and scrum team - development, QA & implementation team
•	Assist in system testing activities and with business stakeholders for UAT testing to meet business requirements and comply with State Medicaid and CHIP regulations

- Subject Matter Expert on building healthcare data integration platform widely used by healthcare payers that curates and organizes healthcare data from multiple sources and in different formats for generating actionable insights
·	Understanding the Abacus domain model which is a foundational aspect of the Abacus Platform, interacting with data ingestion, consumption, and data management
·	Understanding and documenting the requirement for building Foundational Marts (FM) ETL pipeline for data received from multiple sources and in different formats
·	Creating a Source to Target Mapping document used by the development team to build the different Foundational Marts ETL pipeline, for example - Member & Enrollment, Medical Claims, Provider, etc.
·	Work closely with the product management team to understand and analyze new requirements/updates for the FM and assist in proposals for clients
·	Liaison between offshore team and the client for delivery timelines
·	Work as a SCRUM Master for the project and responsible for conducting Agile ceremonies
·	Creating user stories and maintaining JIRA for the project
·	Work closely with Implementation Team to deploy the FM ETL pipeline on production environment of client
·	Liaison with Quality Assurance (QA) team to fix bug raised during the testing phase

• Subject Matter Expert on Quality measure development process for BI-Clinical, CitiusTech’s healthcare analytics platform which is used widely by payers, physicians and hospitals across the United States
• Understand and document the business flow/requirements of eCQM’s (Electronic Clinical Quality measures) of healthcare quality initiatives applicable for the provider industry such as EP (Eligible Professional) & EH (Eligible Hospitals)
• Lead the Clinical informatics team comprising of 15 members to implement various Quality measures for the BI-Clinical platform
• Liaison with Clinical Quality Measure (CQM) stewards like NCQA, CMS etc. for various activities such as licensing, clarification of measure logic, trainings and other related activities
• Interact with the clients in order to understand and document the custom requirements with respect to the CQM logic and other relevant framework requirements
• Work closely with the product management and consulting teams to understand and analyze new requirements/updates for the BI-Clinical platform and prepare proposals for clients
• Creating user stories and maintaining JIRA for the respective initiative
• Work closely with Implementation Team to deploy the measures on production environment of client
• Liaison with Quality Assurance (QA) team to fix bug raised during the testing phase

Understanding the products offered by clients by analyzing policy forms of different states:
•	Worked as a Consultant for understanding the products offered by clients by analyzing policy forms of different states.
•	Responsible for conducting benefit analysis of LTC policies for different states.
•	Fetching the policy data from CAPSIL application database, refining the policy data as per its plan id & product package id and merging the plan id's with similar benefit into a single plan code
•	Assess the nature of system or service issues and resolve technical or sophisticated support problems through independent judgment and advanced problem-solving skills. 
•	Defining INSPRO Configuration Strategy for Individual Product type & configuring the newly created plan into INSPRO application
•	Plan, diagnose and address complex customer questions or problems in the areas of system configurations/setup, product functionality, and bugs/enhancements.
•	Test fixes and perform post resolution follow ups to ensure problems have been accurately resolved using standard testing methodologies.
•	Provide product training to internal & external stake holders.

• Driven professional with 6+ years of IT experience in Requirement Gathering & Application Support
• In-depth knowledge of SDLC & documentation including BRD, SRS, Business Flow diagrams, Implementation and Post implementation support.
  • Excellent knowledge of Revenue Cycle Management in Healthcare sector
  • Excellent knowledge of HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act), Medicare
     & Medicaid programs in Healthcare sector 
  • Expertise in understanding Healthcare Standards like EMR, EHR, ICD, CPT, EDI & 
     HL7 V2.x (Basics)
• Experience in developing Use Cases, creating Screen Mock ups, Conducting GAP Analysis, Impact Analysis, and Cost Benefit Analysis
• Expertise in understanding and analysing Client Requirements.
• Effective Team Leader working with cross -cultural teams and enabling knowledge sharing among the team.
• Self Starter, Highly motivated team player with excellent Interpersonal, Analytical and Problem Solving Skills.
• Excellent Verbal & Communication skills
• Efficient management of stakeholder relationships at all levels of the business (both internal and external parties).
• Experience in presenting to senior management & explain analytical findings with emphasis on recommending solutions.

•	Maintained B2C web portals focused on user acquisition for Individual Insurance business. 
•	Conducted requirement walkthrough sessions with business, development, and testing teams, preparing Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and Data Flow Diagrams.
•	Created product prototypes to gather user feedback, tested with end users and translated insights into actionable features, resulting in a 20% improvement in user satisfaction scores
•	Performed root cause analysis for frequently reported issues to create new features that reduced production issues, and provided support for production implementation, ensuring SLA met for all application issues, resolving 95% of priority 1 issues within SLA. 
•	Conducting internal audits to achieve process compliance, resulting in 100% process compliance for two consecutive years.
